steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Without touching the brake pedal, press ENGINE START/STOP so the ignition is in ON/RUN. Do not start the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Without touching the brake, press ENGINE START/STOP to switch the ignition off.
Start the engine. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: The 2016 guide says the oil life can also be reset from the Oil Life screen under Vehicle Info in the cluster menu.

steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to ON/RUN but do not start the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Turn the key back to OFF/LOCK.
Start the engine. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.

tpms.when: 2016 300 (no reset button; the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, using your own gauge.
Drive normally. After the tires are filled, the car may need about 20 minutes of driving above 15 mph before the light goes out.
There is no button or menu reset; the light clears once the system reads the corrected pressures.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, that is a system fault, not low air, and filling the tires will not clear it.
